title: Elements and Compounds
seo_title: Grade 7 Science: Elements and Compounds Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Elements consist of one type of atom, and compounds consist of atoms of different elements chemically combined: pure substances, elements and compounds, chemical symbols, and chemical changes. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 7, Chemistry)
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 science worksheets (BC): atoms, elements and compounds, chemical symbols and formulas, the periodic table, and chemical changes. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: An element has only one kind of atom.
key_sub: A compound has two or more elements joined chemically.
body_html:
How to think about it

An element is a pure substance made of one kind of atom, like oxygen (O) or iron (Fe). A compound is a pure substance made of two or more elements chemically joined, like water (H2O). The periodic table lists all the elements.

A chemical formula shows the atoms in a compound: CO2 has one carbon and two oxygen atoms. In a chemical change, atoms rearrange to make new substances. Signs include a new colour, gas, heat or light.

Example

How many atoms are in one molecule of H2O?

2 hydrogen + 1 oxygen

Answer: 3

Example

Is salt (NaCl) an element or a compound?

Count the symbols.

Answer: a compound

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a compound is just a mixture (it is chemically joined).
  • Reading CO as cobalt (Co).
  • Thinking melting is a chemical change.

faq.q: Why are chemical symbols used worldwide?
faq.a: So scientists who speak different languages can understand each other.

faq.q: Can a compound be separated by filtering?
faq.a: No, only a chemical reaction can break it apart.

items.q: Is flour stirred into water a solution or a suspension?
items.e: A solution is clear and does not settle; a suspension is cloudy, its solid particles settle and can be filtered.

items.q: What is a solution?

a mixture formed when a solute dissolves in a solvent
items.e: Sea water is a solution.
